svg.title: vinoPop: selecting a paragraph pops a bar of buttons, Summarize streams a summary from the local model, then selecting a shell command offers Run in terminal
svg.text: The NPU kept segfaulting after long quantization runs. It turned
out the kernel module leaks state between sessions, and reloading
it clears that. vinoPop now probes the NPU in a subprocess before
loading a model, and falls back to the GPU instead of crashing.
sudo modprobe -r intel_vpu && sudo modprobe intel_vpu
